comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Yep, sorry. I was in a bit of a rush when I posted it. Goof corrected via reposting.

EQ stats: +1 Crafts Trading, 2400 fame to equip, head-slot item (obviously), and unisex with no job class restrictions. Can only be produced through an R11 Sewing recipe in Quarters Production.

Please note that the recipe in question is only visible with:

1. Adept of Ages (14th Century) title equipped; this title seems to only be available from completing Xanadu quests, which require a lot of work to unlock, or possibly by equipping EX Alchemy enhanced EQ imbued with the 14th Century title (may or may not be available in GAMA at this time, and isn't cheap or easy to accomplish)
2. R11 or higher Sewing naturally, or through skill boosts
3. An Aide with +1 Sewing to break the R10 skill level cap in Sewing

Ingredients:
Corduroy x30
Embroidery Thread x20
Fine Dye x5

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4766 (recipe/stats), fashionamagiya.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-283.html (images)
